topics.title: Andy Rooney Suspended Over Remarks
topics.summary: CBS News suspended Andy Rooney for three months following controversial comments about homosexuality, sparking public outcry and a review of his future role with the company. Executives are assessing the situation due to concerns regarding Rooney’s statements without directly addressing their content or evaluating the specific details.

topics.title: Andy Rooney and Haunted House Sale
topics.summary: During the broadcast, discussions centered around several unusual events. Andy Rooney was criticized for an ‘interview,’ while concerns were raised about Jim Jensen’s health and behavior. The conversation then shifted to Corey Feldman's arrest involving heroin balloons and a disturbing incident at MTV where he allegedly grabbed a woman during a party. Finally, the host discussed a house in Nyack, New York, that was haunted by poltergeists and being sold for $32,000.

topics.title: Ghostly Real Estate Investment
topics.summary: George Kreske attempts to purchase a Victorian house on the Hudson River believing it might be haunted and thus valuable for marketing purposes. Despite his enthusiasm and claims of potential value, he doesn’t make an offer and ultimately fails to secure the property due to concerns about the homeowner's wife.

topics.title: Howard Stern Scouts Johnny Garza
topics.summary: During an interview, Howard Stern repeatedly refuses to allow the young comedian, Johnny Garza, to sit down during his appearance, citing concerns about controlling the show. The conversation shifts to discussing other comedians and their television appearances like ‘Star Search,’ establishing rules while simultaneously expressing a desire for recognition.

topics.title: Gary’s Signal & The AIDS Shot
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio show, host attempts to decipher Gary’s cryptic hand signal and discusses callers trying to win concert tickets. Later, he introduces Cardinal O’Connor promoting an unusual AIDS vaccine after testing it on Rexary the cat while also discussing dating Debbie Gibson and Taylor Dayne.
